memberdef.name: ml_regex_find

detaileddescription.para: Updates Buffer after writing bytes directly to its internal nodes. Count can be 0 to start writing. After a call to this function, Buffer->Space will be greater than 0.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes written to the buffer.

simplesect.para: The address to write up to Buffer->Space bytes.

detaileddescription.para: Updates Buffer after reading bytes directly from its internal nodes. Count can be 0 to start writing.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes read from the buffer.

simplesect.para: The number of available bytes to read from the buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the next available bytes to read from Buffer.
